items.q: Are German public universities really tuition-free for international Master’s students?
items.a: Yes! In 15 out of 16 German federal states, public universities charge €0 tuition fees to both EU and international students. You only pay a nominal semester contribution (€150–€350) which typically includes unlimited regional public transit (Semesterticket).

items.q: Can I study a Master’s in Germany completely in English?
items.a: Absolutely. Germany offers more than 1,800 Master’s programs taught 100% in English, particularly in Computer Science, AI, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Biotechnology, and Business Management. No German language certificate is required for admission to these programs.

items.q: Do I need the dMAT for my Master’s application?
items.a: The dMAT (Digital Masters Admission Test) is required or strongly recommended by leading German universities (such as RWTH Aachen, TUM) and forms part of the APS pathway for Indian applicants in specific STEM disciplines. Our team evaluates your syllabus and provides full mock preparation.

items.q: What is the minimum CGPA required for a Master’s in Germany?
items.a: German universities use the Bavarian formula. A CGPA of 7.0–7.5+ (equivalent to 2.5 or better on the German 1.0–4.0 scale) is competitive for numerous public universities, while top TU9 programs typically look for 8.0+ along with strong credit matching in core subject modules.

items.q: How does the 18-month post-study work visa and EU Blue Card work?
items.a: Upon graduation from a German university, international students receive an 18-month Job Seeker Visa to find qualified employment. Once you secure a position meeting minimum threshold criteria, you can immediately transition to the EU Blue Card and achieve permanent residency in as little as 21 to 27 months.

items.q: How does EUROPA FUSION help with the entire application journey?
items.a: We provide end-to-end guidance: academic credit-matching, profile evaluation, university shortlisting, SOP & academic CV drafting, Uni-Assist / direct portal applications, dMAT preparation, APS filing, blocked account setup, and visa appointment guidance.
